lessons.title: Polite Requests

items.meaning: I beg you / I request you
items.example: Je vous prie de bien vouloir m'aider.
items.exampleMeaning: I kindly ask you to help me.

items.meaning: I would like to speak to...
items.example: Je voudrais parler à Monsieur Dupont.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to speak to Mr. Dupont.

items.example: Un instant, je vous en prie.
items.exampleMeaning: A moment, please.

items.example: Donne-moi ton numéro, s'il te plaît.
items.exampleMeaning: Give me your number, please.

items.text: je vous remercie pour votre aide
items.meaning: I thank you for your help
items.example: Je vous remercie pour votre aide précieuse.
items.exampleMeaning: I thank you for your valuable help.

items.example: Je suis désolé, je ne peux pas parler maintenant.
items.exampleMeaning: I am sorry, I cannot talk now.

lessons.tip: Use 'pourriez-vous' for polite requests. It is more formal than 'peux-tu', which is informal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Hello, how can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bonjour, pourriez-vous m'aider, s'il vous plaît ?
dialogue.meaning: Hello, could you help me, please?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Of course, who do you want to reach?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Je voudrais parler à Madame Lefèvre.
dialogue.meaning: I would like to speak to Mrs. Lefèvre.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a receptionist at a company.
scenario.learnerRole: You are calling to speak with someone.
scenario.brief: Ask politely for help and state who you want to speak to.
scenario.goal: You need to ask for assistance in reaching a person.

lessons.title: Spelling Names

items.example: Pouvez-vous épeler votre nom, s'il vous plaît ?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you spell your name, please?
My first name is Marie.
How is your name spelled?
It's Sarah, with two 'a'.
My name has an accent.
It's simple, without an accent.

lessons.tip: When spelling names, use 'épeler' to ask someone to spell it. Be clear about accents.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a colleague taking a call.
scenario.learnerRole: You are giving your name over the phone.
scenario.brief: Provide your name and spell it out clearly.
scenario.goal: You need to ensure your name is understood correctly.

lessons.title: Leaving a Message

items.exampleMeaning: I would like to leave a message.
You can call back later.

items.example: Désolé, je ne suis pas disponible maintenant.
items.exampleMeaning: Sorry, I am not available now.
Thank you for calling back later.
Do you have a number for me?
I will call you back tomorrow.

lessons.tip: Use 'laisser un message' when you want to leave a message. Be polite and clear.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, je voudrais laisser un message.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would like to leave a message.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pour Monsieur Dupont, s'il vous plaît.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Je ne suis pas disponible maintenant, mais je vous rappellerai.
dialogue.meaning: I am not available now, but I will call you back.

scenario.partnerRole: You are taking a message for someone.
scenario.learnerRole: You are leaving a message on the phone.
scenario.brief: Leave a clear message with the recipient's name.
scenario.goal: You need to make sure the message is taken correctly.

lessons.title: Taking a Message

items.exampleMeaning: I will take a message.
Who is calling, please?

items.example: Quel est le numéro de téléphone ?
items.exampleMeaning: What is the phone number?

items.example: Vous pouvez le joindre au bureau.
items.exampleMeaning: You can reach him at the office.
Thank you for the information, it's helpful.

items.meaning: I will pass on the message
items.example: Je vais transmettre le message à Madame Lefèvre.
items.exampleMeaning: I will pass on the message to Mrs. Lefèvre.

lessons.tip: When taking a message, ask 'qui appelle ?' to know who is calling. It's important to get the details.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Quel est le numéro de téléphone ?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Merci, je vais transmettre le message.
dialogue.meaning: Thank you, I will pass on the message.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a receptionist taking a call.
scenario.learnerRole: You are the caller providing your details.
scenario.brief: Give your name and phone number clearly.
scenario.goal: You need to ensure your details are recorded accurately.

review.title: Chapter Review: Phone Calls and Messages

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: C'est Martin, je voudrais parler à Madame Lefèvre.
dialogue.meaning: It's Martin, I would like to speak to Mrs. Lefèvre.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, je voudrais laisser un message.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would like to leave a message.

scenario.learnerRole: You are a caller leaving a message.
scenario.brief: Engage in a conversation about reaching someone and leaving a message.
scenario.goal: You need to ensure that your message and contact details are taken correctly.
